turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard first?
I asked you two questions, Hale.
But I'm not changing the grade.
Not changing the grade. On what basis?
I'm still not changing it. Keep going if you like.
Then show me what it rests on. Otherwise the principal hears this today.
You can say it ten more ways. The answer is no.
No to what? Your own procedure says the parent is contacted before any mark is entered. Nobody called me.
